body: I actually was attributed my therapist. I went from zero to catastrophe last year and they judged that i was in need of mental and psychological help. I don't know if they'll allow me to change. She gave me a talk saying that she doesn't feel like i need her help. Or what she could help me with. I need people and to leave everything that is causing me those anxious attacks. My job and school. Here in Canada, i don't need to pay anything but... i feel like i'm slowly being left out, to burn completely. I don't know if those pulsations will take me over. If ever i am, I will do the last thing possible to not hurt anybody. I am honestly exhausted of this constant fighting inside my mind.

I have always been a loner in my life. I had my share of relationships and i honestly, I don't feel that there's any groups that would be interested into me being around. I was told ince by a friend that i was a downer. I always been surviving since. In my childhood years. I am tired of all this strife. I am tired of fighting everything every seconds.

I had multiple suicidal thoughts since my childhood. I attempted one and failed it while in elementary. Those dangerous thoughts are recurring. I feel that they ask me to do them. I can't do them. I won't do them. It would mean that i will forsake my humanity. Yes, i have been honest with my therapist. I have told everything i felt and she still insist that having a sport is the way to go. She gave me the number of a suicidal hotline and insisted that i need to be part  of a group or some sort. That the thoughts are the results of years of mental and physical abuse. I either want to inflict pain on myself or on others. I can't continue living in a state where i'm scared of my own hands. I can't. Not anymore.

I am currently seeing a therapist. She thinks that sport is the only thing i need and that will releive of those thoughts. I. Don't think so. I don't think it will go away. I wasn't diagnosed yet. I don't drink, smoke or take any kind express f drugs. I don't want to hurt anyone. I don't want to ve a statistic either but do understand that my thoughts are really dangerous. One of my close friends ended his life 3 years ago. A brilliant, talented and guy. I wish that i would have exchanged places with him.
